meta_description: Listening test: hear pairs of PICO-8 style songs and say which one was composed by AI.
home_title: Human or AI? A PICO-8 listening test
home_hero_text: You will hear pairs of songs made for PICO-8, an 8-bit fantasy console. Some were composed by people, others by artificial intelligence models. We want to know whether your ear can tell them apart.
home_about_text: This test is part of the final project of DCC831, Generative AI for Music, at the Computer Science Department of UFMG (Brazil). We trained models that compose soundtracks for PICO-8 and compare them with real songs from the community. Your listening is the most important measure of the project.
home_privacy_text: Your e-mail only lets you pick up where you left off. It is not stored: the server keeps only a code derived from it, which cannot be turned back into the address. Answers are anonymous and used only for this research.

how_step_listen_text: Each pair has track 1 and track 2, 20 seconds each. Listen to at least 15 seconds of each; you can replay and go back as often as you like.
how_step_answer_title: Say which one was made by AI
how_step_answer_text: It can be one, both or neither. If you cannot decide, pick "I can't tell". There is no right answer you are expected to know: your impression is what counts.
how_step_profile_title: Tell us a bit about yourself
how_step_profile_text: At the end, a short form asks your age, native language and your experience with music and with chiptune.
how_note_text: Every track goes through the same synthesizer at the same loudness, so timbre and volume do not give the answer away. Use headphones if you can.
